claim_text: Christine Altman, president of the Hamilton County board of commissioners, said at a Sunday briefing that the county just north of Indianapolis escaped without any loss of life, while officials assessed whether a significant bridge damaged in the flooding could be repaired or needed complete replacement.
quote: She said the county, located just north of Indianapolis, escaped without any loss of life, though officials were assessing whether a significant bridge damaged in the flooding could be repaired or if it needed to be completely replaced.
confidence_justification: Named public official speaking at an on-record briefing, but the bridge assessment is described as still under way rather than settled by a document.
